ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted against a low-intensity black border and mid-intensity tan/yellowish mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white substrate across both lobes; large, amorphous mid-intensity tan/yellowish patches concentrated in the medial-lateral regions of both lobes; a continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-55 degrees, extending deep into the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; characterized by sharp triangular peaks (3-10 pixels in amplitude) and rounded valleys; highest density of serrations located on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white and beige clusters (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tips and the upper left trailing edge; three small, roughly circular indentations visible on the right lobe mid-surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization on both lateral tips; significant tan/yellowish diatom biofilm coverage distributed across the central-lateral regions of the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark horizontal linear mark (low-intensity) located centrally at the base near the water-line interface.
